A '''singularity''' was a natural phenomenon.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial asteroid base|asteroid base]] developed a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[collector-repulsor array]]. The [[G-wave]]s it gave off resembled those of a singularity.<ref name="Science">{{WEGCite|story=Ain't Science Grand?|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> [[Korpil]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] tested artificial singularities during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
